acceptance.given: The Skill authoring standard is available for inspection.

oracle.expected: The standard explicitly defines how package dependencies are declared.
oracle.observable: A content assertion against the standard document locates its dependency declaration.

acceptance.then: The document assertion confirms that dependency declarations are defined.
acceptance.when: Inspect the standard document and evaluate its required-content assertions.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The planned A01 content assertion for the standard document fails when no dependency declaration is present.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Document the dependency declaration requirements for Skill packages in the authoring standard.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Documentation-only change; no persistent state or schema compatibility impact.

slice_hint.state_transition: The standard moves from being defined without an explicit dependency declaration to documenting dependency declaration requirements.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted A01 standard-content assertion passes and confirms a dependency declaration is present.
